Bundled public response captures for offline tests and demos. No refresh is performed.

- `.`: heyresearch.xyz, priors.trade, hookr.fun, app.sherwood.sh; captured 2026-11-09; 8 long dashes replaced with colons, no privacy redactions.
- `v01/`: heyresearch.xyz; 2026-11-08 response asOf (capture wall clock not separately recorded); 8 long dashes replaced with colons, no privacy redactions.
- `r4/`: heyresearch.xyz, hookr.fun; captured 2026-11-09; 6 appended HTTP/timing annotations removed, 23 long dashes replaced with colons, no privacy redactions.
- `r5/`: dashboard.agentwormhole.com, t0ll.xyz, api.dexscreener.com, api.geckoterminal.com, docs.offrouter.org, rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com; captured 2026-11-09; 18 appended HTTP/timing annotations removed, 1 long dash replaced with a colon, no privacy redactions.
- `r6/`: sentinelhood.com, trnch.fun, borro.markets, heyresearch.xyz, rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com; captured 2026-11-09; HTTP/timing annotations removed, long dashes normalized, no privacy redactions.

Long dashes are normalized to follow the repository punctuation rule. In HEY citation text, the three colon substitutions are replaced with commas; HEY's own citation name and other text are retained. The MCP search capture omits one unrelated project row; its source-reported total is unchanged. All other response fields are unchanged. Public contract and third-party deployer/agent addresses, an attestation signature and authentication-method names are response data, not local wallets or credentials. HoodLock fixtures include public JSON-RPC request parameters with their responses. Toll's quoted untrusted agent text remains here under tests and is read as data only.

Fifteen remaining source en dashes in five JSON captures use Unicode escapes. This changes only the file encoding; decoded response values are unchanged. Card rendering normalizes that punctuation as described above.
